newsitem.title: USA: Exxon says 102,000 bpd La. cat cracker down.
newsitem.headline: Exxon says 102,000 bpd La. cat cracker down.

text.p: Exxon said one of two catalytic cracking units at its Baton Rouge, Louisiana, refinery would be down for a "few days," pending repair of a regenerated catalyst feed line.
An Exxon spokesman said the downed cat cracker has a capacity of 102,000 barrels per day (bpd).
"This will be a short duration deal," said the Exxon spokesman, who refused to specify a time for the unit's return.
The cat cracker problem was first indentified on Sunday, leaving the unit down since that time. Exxon said customer supplies would not be effected by the repair work.
The Baton Rouge facility has an operating capacity of 424,000 bpd.
